definitions.explanation: Any organism that is alive, including animals and plants.
Often refers specifically to animals or creatures.

notes:
{生|い}き{物|もの} is the everyday word for any living creature. While it technically covers all living organisms, in practice it most often refers to animals and other moving creatures.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {生|い}き{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep a creature as a pet
- {生|い}き{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise living things
- {生|い}き{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧: to value living things

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧:
- {生|い}き{物|もの}: everyday, warm, often implies animals. Used in conversation and by children.
- ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧: scientific, academic. Used in biology (⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧) and textbooks.
